scripts.build: bun run --filter @fazelstudio/fazelidraw build && bun run --filter @fazelstudio/react build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @fazelstudio/fazelidraw typecheck && bun run --filter @fazelstudio/react typecheck
scripts.check:all: bun run lint --fix && bun run typecheck && bun run build
scripts.publish:core: bun run build:core && cd packages/core && npm publish
scripts.publish:react: bun run build && cd packages/react && npm publish
scripts.publish:all: bun run publish:core && bun run publish:react
